general-knot-reference.name: General knot-tying technique (cross-checked against multiple technical/maritime references)
general-knot-reference.note: Knot-tying technique is centuries-old functional/utilitarian method, not original creative expression - identical step sequences appear across countless independent sources (maritime, military, mountaineering) with no single owner. Written originally for this reference, cross-checked against widely-corroborated technique rather than copied from any one source.

dod-fm-5-125-rigging.name: FM 5-125, Rigging Techniques, Procedures, and Applications (US Army)
dod-fm-5-125-rigging.note: A specific candidate diagram source (this manual) was investigated for retention in an earlier session but not retained without direct cover-page/distribution-statement confirmation, since no PDF tool was installed at the time. Now that poppler-utils is available, the PDF was downloaded and inspected directly with pdftotext: it carries its own "DISTRIBUTION RESTRICTION: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited" statement, and is a Headquarters, Department of the Army field manual - a work of the US federal government, public domain under 17 U.S.C. Sec. 105. Retained in full in the Document Library, and used as the verified source for a small set of correctly-depicted knot diagrams below (selective extraction, not the full figure set).
